hints.content:
Let's find the constant  of proportionality.   

In the proportional relationship between $a$ and $b$, one constant of proportionality is the number we multiply by $a$ to get $b$.

$a\, \times\,  ?=b$

$a$ | $b$ | Relationship 
:-: | :-: | :-:
$8$ | $3$ | ${8}\times\blueD{\dfrac{3}{8}}=3$
$24$ | $9$ | ${24}\times\blueD{\dfrac{3}{8}}=9$
$40$ | $15$ |  ${40}\times\blueD{\dfrac{3}{8}}=15$

The constant of proportionality is $\blueD{\dfrac{3}{8}}$.  This means we can multiply $\blueD{\dfrac{3}{8}}$ by $a$ to get $b$.

Now, let's represent that as an equation.  

$\begin{align}
{b}&=\blueD{\text{constant of proportionality}}\times{a} \\\\
{b}&=\blueD{\dfrac{3}{8}}a
\end{align}$
